additional_info.subject: ID0443345-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / R3 170001592]PLC refresh issue CRM:02698000402
additional_info.body:
Hello Szilard,
Please follow this guide on how to flash a USB with LiveLinux and use the Restore-config:
https://wiki.siemens.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=en&title=3+-+Live+Linux+Userscripts
I send in attachment the config files for the restore-config script.
Please download and use Rufus (free software) to flash the USB as we have better experiences with this software.
After flashing the CFAST with v4.0.11 on Companion Tool (config files only available for this version, do not install any other version or it might go wrong), please use the LiveLinux USB and insert on the "scripts to run" the restore-config and delete the extra ones in the "scripts to run" folder, there should be a dummy and copy-tar there, delete them.
I believe you already have a USB stick from the training you did here in Portugal, please let me know, otherwise I will send the image via Secufex, since it's too big to send via email.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
